DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML)

The MRI confirms multifocal demyelinating lesions in the brain without enhancement, which is the hallmark of PML, a opportunistic infection typically caused by the JC virus in immunocompromised individuals. Since we have ruled out common infectious and metabolic causes with your normal blood work, I need to determine your current immune status to identify the underlying cause of your immunosuppression. Do you have a history of HIV/AIDS, are you currently taking immunosuppressive medications for conditions like cancer or autoimmune disorders, or have you undergone an organ transplant?
